reviewNotes: Reviewed all 127 keys against all 20 cards and explicit furigana in data/pages30.json. Context-specific topic は, contrast では and には rendered わ. Directional へ in substrate, food and transformation destinations rendered え. Object を rendered お. Preserved lexical はんしょく, はっこう, はっちょうみそ, はこび, はたらき, はたらく, はたらける, はし and へんか. In たんぱくしつにはたらき the は belongs to 働き and remains unchanged. Loanwords transcribed to hiragana with long vowels retained: あみらーぜ, ぷろてあーぜ, りぱーぜ, あみのさん, ぺぷちど, あるこーる and こく. Explicit technical readings including たねこうじ, ほうし, しゅぼ, むぎじょうちゅう, せいせいぶつ, じゅくせいこう, せいいくちゅう and つけどこ retained. Display labels and lookup keys unchanged. No listening or pitch-accent verification.
